title: Multiplication Basics
objectives: Multiply multi-digit numbers using the standard algorithm
Apply multiplication to solve real-world problems

introduction.context: Multiplication helps us calculate quickly when we have equal groups - like finding the total number of items in several boxes, calculating area, or determining costs for multiple items.
introduction.connection: Multiplication builds on your addition skills from Chapter 2, using repeated addition as the foundation for understanding this new operation.

concepts.title: Multiplication as Repeated Addition
concepts.content: Multiplication is a shortcut for adding the same number multiple times. 4 × 3 means adding 4 three times.

concepts.title: The Standard Multiplication Algorithm
concepts.content: For larger numbers, we use the standard algorithm with partial products, multiplying each digit and adding the results.

commonErrors: Misaligning partial products in multi-digit multiplication

hints: Think of this as 7 groups of 8
practice.explanation: 7 × 8 = 56. This is a basic multiplication fact that should be memorized.
